Remark
[Discrete Hölder and Minkowski inequalities] ↗ lem:holders-inequality ↗ lem:minkowskis-inequality 1. appB:B.2-f-rem\group Elementary Inequalities

For $a,b\in \R ^n$, $1\leq p<\infty $, and $p^{-1}+q^{-1}=1$, \[ (10)\qquad \begin{cases} \displaystyle \left|\sum _{k=1}^na_kb_k\right| \leq \left(\sum _{k=1}^n|a_k|^p\right)^{1/p} \left(\sum _{k=1}^n|b_k|^q\right)^{1/q},\\[1em] \displaystyle \left(\sum _{k=1}^n|a_k+b_k|^p\right)^{1/p} \leq \left(\sum _{k=1}^n|a_k|^p\right)^{1/p} +\left(\sum _{k=1}^n|b_k|^p\right)^{1/p}. \end{cases} \]
